summaries.label: Complete sets
summaries.formula: floor(spirit_train / 4) + floor(wooden_train / 4) + floor(steel_train / 4) + floor(skull_train / 4) + floor(stagecoach_train / 4) + floor(dragonhead_train / 4) + floor(sweet_train / 4) + floor(golden_train / 4)

sections.title: Spirit Train
sections.note: The four parts you're given in the story: a full Spirit Train has 4 hearts.

items.name: Spirit Engine
items.howTo: Anjean turns the statue in the Tower of Spirits' lobby into the Spirit Train after the first climb.
items.notes: Comes with the Solid Passenger Car.

items.name: Practical Cannon
items.howTo: Alfonzo fits it in Aboda Village after you bring him home (after the Snow Rail Map).

items.name: Solid Passenger Car
items.howTo: Part of the Spirit Train from the start.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon gives the European name, Stalwart Car.

items.name: Trusty Freight Car
items.howTo: Kagoron lends it in Goron Village when he asks for Mega Ice.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon gives the European name, Reliable Wagon.

sections.title: Wooden Train
sections.note: Trade Treasure with Linebeck III at the Trading Post once the bridge is rebuilt. A full set has 6 hearts, a mixed train 5.

items.name: Wooden Engine
items.howTo: Trade Linebeck III 2 Wood Hearts, 2 Star Fragments, 1 Dark Pearl Loop.

items.name: Wooden Cannon
items.howTo: Trade Linebeck III 2 Wood Hearts, 1 Stalfos Skull, 1 Ruto Crown.

items.name: Wood Passenger Car
items.howTo: Trade Linebeck III 1 Wood Heart, 1 Bee Larvae, 1 Dragon Scale.

items.name: Wooden Freight Car
items.howTo: Trade Linebeck III 1 Wood Heart, 2 Demon Fossils, 1 Pearl Necklace.

sections.title: Golden Train
sections.note: A full set has 8 hearts. Needs 2 Alchemy Stones and 2 Regal Rings; see the Minigames & Secrets tracker for where they are.

items.name: Golden Engine
items.howTo: Trade Linebeck III 1 Alchemy Stone, 2 Ancient Gold Pieces, 3 Mystic Jades.

items.name: Brawny Cannon
items.howTo: Trade Linebeck III 1 Alchemy Stone, 3 Palace Dishes, 2 Goron Ambers.
items.notes: IGN calls it the Golden Cannon (the European name).

items.name: Royal Passenger Car
items.howTo: Trade Linebeck III 1 Regal Ring, 4 Dragon Scales, 2 Ancient Gold Pieces.
items.notes: IGN calls it the Golden Passenger Car.

items.name: Golden Freight Car
items.howTo: Trade Linebeck III 1 Regal Ring, 4 Pearl Necklaces, 1 Mystic Jade.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki says 2 Mystic Jades; Zelda Dungeon and IGN say 1.
